name: gate_sink (deploy gate: swallows every outbound call, sends nothing)

meta.note: Reached only from the gate copy of the Concierge (tests/build_gate.py), at localhost:5678 inside the n8n container. Answers every Twilio / Resend / cockpit call with a canned success carrying a FRESH Twilio sid and Resend id on every call so the gate copy behaves as if the send worked, while nothing leaves the server. Executions are not saved: the bodies are gate messages.
